name: Farmers First Ag Index
description: Statistically validated index of U.S. agricultural financial conditions. Predicts national ag production loan delinquency using Federal Reserve economic data.

model.target: USDA national ag production loan delinquency (DRFAPGACBS)

validation.regime_accuracy_note: 73.2% of quarters correctly classified above/below median delinquency

composite.description: National agricultural financial conditions. Higher = lower delinquency risk.
composite.method: Soybean price + Federal Funds rate regression scored against expanding historical window

grain.description: Row crop margin conditions. Revenue (corn/soy/wheat) minus costs (energy/fertilizer/machinery/interest).

dairy.description: Dairy margin conditions. Revenue (milk/cheese/butter) minus costs (corn/soy feed, energy, interest).

livestock.description: Livestock margin conditions. Revenue (cattle/hogs) minus costs (corn/soy feed, energy, interest).

outlook.description: Forward 12-15 month outlook based on Federal Funds rate trajectory. Rate cuts predict improving conditions 4-5 quarters ahead.
outlook.method: 4-quarter change in Federal Funds rate, scored against expanding window

STRONG.interpretation: Strong conditions. Low delinquency risk. Favorable for expansion.

GUARDED.interpretation: Below-average conditions. Watch margins. Maximize insurance.

STRESSED.interpretation: Elevated stress. High delinquency risk. Preserve cash.

structural_validation.grain_vs_dairy_note: Inverse: corn is revenue for grain, cost for dairy

data_sources.name: Soybeans
data_sources.role: Grain revenue, Composite predictor, Dairy/Livestock cost

data_sources.name: Federal Funds Rate
data_sources.role: Composite predictor, Cost component (all sectors), Outlook driver

update_frequency: Quarterly (after FRED publishes complete quarter data)
